### How a request moves through nexus-rag

```
  Browser / LibreChat
        │  (OIDC login via Keycloak)
        ▼
  ┌───────────────┐   publish job    ┌──────────┐   consume    ┌──────────────────┐
  │ ingestion-api │ ───────────────▶ │   NATS   │ ───────────▶ │ ingestion-worker │
  └───────┬───────┘   (NFR-11)       └──────────┘              └────────┬─────────┘
          │ original file                                        parse→chunk→embed
          ▼                                                             │ writes vectors
     object store                                                       ▼
                                                                    ┌────────┐
  Query path:                                                       │ Qdrant │
  LibreChat ─▶ orchestration-mcp ─(dense+BM25)▶ Qdrant ─▶ reranker  └────────┘
                    │  embed query                         (cross-encoder)
                    ▼
                 Ollama

  Generation path:  LibreChat ─▶ LiteLLM ─▶ Ollama
```

**Boxes** are green when the component is up, red when down. **Links** animate (marching ants) and turn green while data is actively flowing on that hop, red when the hop is idle (no flow in 5m) or an endpoint is down.

targets.expr: label_replace(up{job=~"nexus-rag-.*"}, "component", "$1", "job", "nexus-rag-(.*)") or label_replace(up{job=~"qdrant|nats|postgres|keycloak"}, "component", "$1", "job", "(.*)") or label_replace(vector(1), "component", "librechat", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "component", "litellm", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "component", "ollama", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "component", "object-store", "", "")

label_replace((sum(rate(keycloak_credentials_password_hashing_validations_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-auth", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_ingestion_submissions_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-upload", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_ingestion_queue_publish_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-publish", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_ingestion_worker_jobs_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-consume", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_ingestion_worker_stage_seconds_count{stage="vector_upsert"}[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-upsert", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_ingestion_worker_document_bytes_count[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-objstore", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_ingestion_worker_jobs_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-status", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_ingestion_worker_stage_seconds_count{stage="embed"}[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-embedI", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_queries_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-query", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_query_stage_seconds_count{stage="embed"}[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-embedQ", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_query_stage_seconds_count{stage="retrieve"}[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-vquery", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_reranker_requests_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-rerank", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_queries_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-genin", "", "") or label_replace((sum(rate(nexus_rag_reranker_requests_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0, "edge", "edge-gen", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(up{job=~"nexus-rag-.*"}, "node", "$1", "job", "nexus-rag-(.*)"), "node", "${1}_${2}", "node", "(.+)-(.+)") or label_replace(up{job=~"qdrant|nats|postgres|keycloak"}, "node", "$1", "job", "(.*)") or label_replace(vector(1), "node", "librechat", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "node", "litellm", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "node", "ollama", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "node", "object_store", "", "")

options.content:
graph LR
  subgraph AUTH[AUTHENTICATION]
    keycloak[Keycloak]
    librechat[LibreChat]
  end

  subgraph INGEST[INGESTION]
    ingestion_api[ingestion-api]
    nats{{NATS}}
    ingestion_worker[ingestion-worker]
    qdrant[(Qdrant)]
    object_store[(object store)]
    postgres[(Postgres)]
  end

  subgraph RETRIEVE[RETRIEVAL]
    orchestration_mcp[orchestration-mcp]
    reranker[reranker]
  end

  subgraph GENERATE[GENERATION]
    litellm[LiteLLM]
    ollama[Ollama]
  end

  keycloak -- OIDC --> librechat
  librechat -- upload --> ingestion_api
  ingestion_api -- publish --> nats
  nats -- consume --> ingestion_worker
  ingestion_worker -- vectors --> qdrant
  ingestion_api -. original .-> object_store
  ingestion_worker -. audit .-> postgres
  ingestion_worker -. embed .-> ollama
  librechat -- query --> orchestration_mcp
  orchestration_mcp -- retrieve --> qdrant
  orchestration_mcp -- rerank --> reranker
  orchestration_mcp -. embed .-> ollama
  librechat -- prompt --> litellm
  litellm -- generate --> ollama
